## HueMux v0.0.2-alpha.9 — light control feels instant now

> **Alpha.** The changes below were measured on a real wall panel driving a
> LAN-hosted instance. Not tested on Windows or macOS, and the Android APK has
> still never run on a phone.

### Tapping a light used to take half a second. Now it takes ten milliseconds.

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| Single tap → visible change | 420–480 ms | **6–17 ms** |
| Five rapid taps | 1435, 1321, 602, 396, 369 ms | **12, 45, 53, 29, 16 ms** |
| All-lights toggle | worst case | **53 ms** |
| Full grid rebuilds per action | 2 | **0** |

The interesting part is the second row. Latency used to *compound* — each tap
made the next one slower — so a few impatient presses turned into multi-second
delays. That is gone.

**What was actually wrong**, having measured rather than guessed: the
WebSocket was never slow (5 ms from touch to bytes on the wire), and neither
was the Go server. Two things were:

- **Nothing happened until the bridge answered.** Every tap waited ~460 ms for
  an HTTPS call to the bridge and an event coming back before the UI moved. The
  UI now applies the change immediately and reconciles when the event arrives.
- **Every event rebuilt the entire grid.** A message about one light caused all
  twelve cards, every scene chip and every gradient to be destroyed and
  recreated — ~745 ms of blocking work, twice per action. Now only the affected
  card is touched.

Correctness was checked, not assumed: after a burst of toggles every card's
state was compared against the server. No mismatches.

### Also

- **Simple Light and Simple Dark themes.** Fewer effects, every accent colour
  kept — a light's own colour becomes a tinted border instead of a blurred
  wash. Stored per-device in the browser, so a wall panel can run simple while
  your phone keeps the full look. Honest note: this was expected to help
  performance and, measured, it does not. It is a look-and-feel choice.
- **Rooms can be favourited.** The star was simply missing from the room tile,
  even though everything behind it already worked. A favourited room now shows
  its bulk tile in the Favorites view.
- **[ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md)** —
  the request path, where the latency goes, and the measurements above.
